paite: Pathian aw, ka kikou husa na za inla; ka thumna ngaikhia in.
heading: David La / Humbitna Dia Thumna
english: For the Chief Musician. For a stringed instrument. By David. Hear my cry, God. Listen to my prayer.

paite: Ka lungtang abah lai in kawlmong a kipan ka hon sam ahi. Kei sang a sangzaw suangpi ah hon pi in.
english: From the end of the earth, I will call to you when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

paite: Nang kei a ding in humbitna melmate lak ah galven insang kiptak na hi ngal a.
english: For you have been a refuge for me, a strong tower from the enemy.

paite: Na puanin ah tangtawn in ka om ding a, na kha nuai bukna mun ah ka muang ding hi. Selah
english: I will dwell in your tent forever. I will take refuge in the shelter of your wings. Selah.

paite: Pathian aw, nang ka thuchiamte na ngaikhia a, na min laudan siamte gam luah tuh na hon pia hi.
english: For you, God, have heard my vows. You have given me the heritage of those who fear your name.

paite: Kumpipa damsung hihsau in, akumte suan tampi bang ahi ding.
english: You will prolong the king’s life. His years will be for generations.

paite: Pathian ma ah tangtawn in a-om gige ding, aw, amah ah zahngaihna leh thutak bawl in, amah humbittu ding in.
english: He shall be enthroned in God’s presence forever. Appoint your loving kindness and truth, that they may preserve him.

paite: Huchi in ka thuchiamte niteng a ka hihtheihna ding in, tangtawn in na min phat in la ka sa ding hi.
english: So I will sing praise to your name forever, that I may fulfill my vows daily.
